items.exampleEn: Signing this paper puts you under no obligation to buy anything.
items.exampleZh: 簽這張紙並不代表你有義務要買任何東西。

items.exampleEn: The festival helps young people learn about their heritage through music.
items.exampleZh: 這個節慶幫助年輕人透過音樂認識自己的文化傳統。

items.exampleEn: Before every game, the player does the same strange ritual.
items.exampleZh: 每場比賽前，那位選手都會做同樣奇怪的儀式。

items.exampleEn: Free parking is a privilege for staff who live far away.
items.exampleZh: 免費停車是住得遠的員工才有的特權。

items.exampleEn: The pastor knows the name of every child in the village.
items.exampleZh: 那位牧師叫得出村裡每個孩子的名字。

items.exampleEn: Equity means giving each student the help they need.
items.exampleZh: 公平就是給每個學生他們所需要的幫助。

items.exampleEn: "Racism has no place in sports," the coach told his players.
items.exampleZh: 「運動場上容不下種族歧視。」教練對他的球員說。

items.exampleEn: A small memorial stands where the old train station used to be.
items.exampleZh: 舊火車站原本的位置立著一座小紀念碑。

items.sentenceEn: The old tea factory is now part of the town's cultural heritage.
items.sentenceZh: 那座老茶廠現在是鎮上文化遺產的一部分。

items.audioEn: Our pastor asked volunteers to help clean the park on Saturday morning.
items.audioZh: 我們的牧師請志工星期六早上幫忙打掃公園。
options: Tidy up the park on the weekend

items.sentenceEn: Drinking tea with my grandmother on Sundays has become a family ritual.
items.sentenceZh: 星期天和奶奶一起喝茶，已經成了我們家的例行習慣。

items.sentenceEn: It was a privilege to work with such a talented team.
items.sentenceZh: 能和這麼優秀的團隊一起工作是我的榮幸。

items.stemEn: Parents have a legal ____ to send their children to school.
items.stemZh: 父母有法定義務送孩子上學。

items.stemEn: To create ____, the company now pays men and women the same for the same job.
items.stemZh: 為了促進公平，公司現在讓做同樣工作的男女領同樣的薪水。

items.passageEn: For a school project on local heritage, Kai interviewed three older people in his town. The first was a retired pastor who had helped build the town's memorial to the doctor who opened its first hospital. The second, a woman from a fishing family, described a ritual her family still performs before the first boat trip of each year. The third was a teacher who spoke about equity and about how the town fought racism when new families arrived. Kai said that hearing their stories was a privilege, not just a school obligation. Later, the local newspaper wrote an editorial praising his project.
items.passageZh: 為了一個關於地方文化遺產的學校專題，Kai 訪問了鎮上三位長者。第一位是一位退休牧師，他曾幫忙建造鎮上的紀念碑，紀念那位開了鎮上第一家醫院的醫生。第二位是一位來自漁民家庭的婦人，她描述了她家每年第一次出海前仍會進行的儀式。第三位老師談到公平，也談到新家庭搬來時小鎮如何對抗種族歧視。Kai 說，聽他們的故事是一種榮幸，而不只是學校規定的義務。後來，地方報紙還寫了一篇社論稱讚他的專題。

questions.questionZh: 那位退休牧師曾經幫忙做什麼？
對 Kai 來說，聽這些故事是什麼？
options: 一份很無聊的學校作業
了解漁業工作的好機會

items.promptZh: 這所學校教學生如何對抗種族歧視。
referenceEn: This school teaches students how to fight racism.
The school teaches its students to stand up against racism.
rubricZh: 「種族歧視」可寫，例如 racism 等
「對抗」可寫，例如 fight、stand up against 等
teach 後可接 how to 或直接接人＋to（例如 teaches students how to、teaches students to 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 obligation 造一個句子，說說你覺得自己對家人或社會有什麼義務。
referenceEn: I feel an obligation to visit my grandparents every weekend.
I think I have an obligation to keep my neighborhood clean.
rubricZh: obligation 後面可接 to＋原形動詞（例如 an obligation to help 等）
時態配合內容（例如 feel、have 等）
